## Before you file

[`docs/product/scope.html`](../../docs/product/scope.html) and the anti-scope,

(parked ideas). silo is deliberately small; a lot is out of scope on purpose.

- [ ] I've read the scope docs and this is in scope (or I explain why it should be).

## The problem

What pain are you hitting? What can't you do today?

What you'd like silo to do.

How this stays within "capture → structure → serve; the agent does the thinking."
